endings.name: The One Who Stayed
endings.summary: He sat on the elders' bench at the Recognition. The shaft sealed and cut his brothers' voices at once; he kept his blue a while longer, felt each of them go as a skipped beat in the wall, and dims the lamps for the next group. A last image, years on: old, he climbs the shaft alone; a raft waits with his mark in its flank, and four small figures come out of the bone. He carries others to the parting he refused.

endings.name: Taken by the River
endings.summary: A Warden took him before the heart. In its hold his gift begins to sink into the skin among the gifts it has kept; holding it means he cannot knock for the raft. He is turned aside into his own vessel, with the gift or without it. The ending is his alone: the rest of the raft reach the heart with an empty place and are separated as written.

endings.name: Two Together
endings.summary: Two brothers who rowed in time all river long squeezed on the song's last note and were swept into one chamber. Everyone else is lost to them. After three minutes a valve opens between the two, without struggle or prompt, and each is carried on alone: "…never lets you hold what you love for long."

endings.name: Carried Away
endings.summary: The current splits in the heart and every brother is swept a different way, holding the tool another carved for him. In the vessel he turns it over and finds the Underside, if his brother cut one. "No one stays together."
